name: @serifpersia/dango
description: A web application for watching anime.

scripts.prebuild: node -e "if(!String(process.env.npm_config_user_agent||'').startsWith('pnpm/')){console.error('[dango] Use pnpm, not npm. Run: pnpm run build');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.prelint: node -e "if(!String(process.env.npm_config_user_agent||'').startsWith('pnpm/')){console.error('[dango] Use pnpm, not npm. Run: pnpm run lint');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.preformat: node -e "if(!String(process.env.npm_config_user_agent||'').startsWith('pnpm/')){console.error('[dango] Use pnpm, not npm. Run: pnpm run format');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.lint: pnpm run format:check && pnpm -r --if-present run lint && pnpm run typecheck
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter dango-server exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter dango-client exec tsc -b
